name: rich-presence
description: Shows what your coding assistant is doing as your Discord status. Needs Claude Code 2.1.271 or later. Unofficial: not affiliated with, endorsed by, or sponsored by Anthropic or Discord.

privacy.title: Privacy level
privacy.description: How much is shown: off (nothing), minimal (that the assistant is in use), standard (adds status and model family) or full (adds the project name).

discord_application_id.title: Discord application id (optional)
discord_application_id.description: Leave empty to use the built-in Discord application. Only digits.
